notes: Source = introduced Senate text (S.629 IS, 3836 chars, read in full). versionChanges.unchanged=true through Enrolled, so the introduced text substantively equals the enacted Public Law 119-102 text. No referencedSources are registered and none were fetched. Two-section amendment to the Agricultural Credit Act of 1978: Sec. 2 amends 16 U.S.C. 2201 (Emergency Conservation Program) to add advance payments (75% of replacement cost / 50% of repair-or-restoration cost, before the work), broaden eligible measures beyond fencing, change a 60-day period to 180-day, and add a wildfire-eligibility clause (federally-caused wildfires and natural spread of human-caused wildfires); Sec. 3 amends 16 U.S.C. 2206 (Emergency Forest Restoration Program) to add the same wildfire clause, redesignate subsection (e) as (f), and add advance payments (not more than 75% of emergency-measure cost) with a 180-day return-of-unspent-funds requirement. Every substantive figure/entity/direction claim is source-supported. Sole recurring flag (MINOR, source debt): summary/brief/top_lines[1].subs[0]/changes.modified all characterize the 60->180-day change as a 'window/time to use the funds' — but the bill shows only the numeral strike/insert and the statute (16 U.S.C. 2201(b)(2)) was not fetched, so what the period governs is unsourced; the sections[].detail field states it cleanly without the gloss. One MINOR count issue: 'trio of cosponsors' vs two cosponsors in source. One MINOR technical omission: the (e)->(f) redesignation. featured_quotes (Mrs. Fischer, F000463, Nebraska wildfire floor statement) could NOT be audited: the Congressional Record text is not in this bill-text source and no referencedSources were registered.
